title: Basketball Research lists Division I teams only
items: Pace, efficiency per 100 possessions, shooting defense and defensive rebounding listed every school a Division I team had played, so a Division III or NAIA side with one fast game against a D1 opponent could top the Pace table. They now list the 357 Division I teams only.
Games against non-Division I opponents still count in the D1 teams' own numbers; those opponents just no longer get a row.
